parrafo_1.es: Limb Logic Tree Service LLC es una empresa de arbolistas con sede en Port St. Lucie. Carson y su equipo hacen poda de palmas y robles, remoción completa de árboles muertos o caídos, retiro de tocones y limpieza total de escombros.
parrafo_1.en: Limb Logic Tree Service LLC is a tree care company based in Port St. Lucie. Carson and his crew handle palm and oak trimming, full removal of dead or fallen trees, stump removal and complete debris cleanup.

parrafo_2.es: Sus clientes en Google repiten lo mismo: Carson diagnostica el problema real del árbol antes de cobrar un centavo, trae el equipo de protección y las herramientas adecuadas, y deja el patio limpio al terminar.
parrafo_2.en: Customers on Google keep saying the same thing: Carson diagnoses the tree's real problem before charging a cent, brings the right protective gear and tools, and leaves the yard clean when the job is done.

items.quote: Very professional and honest pricing. Carson has all the protective gear and tools/knowledge to take care of the tree. I should call him tree doctor instead, the way he diagnosed what happened to my dead palm and also what needs to be done.

We hired Limb Logic to remove 2 really high coconut palms that unfortunately did not make it through last winter's freeze. Carson did a quick job and removed the stumps too at an amazing price. Plus gave us a lot of knowledge on what to replant. I am going to use him for all our trimmings in the future.
I asked Carson to clean up my palmetto and he did exactly what I wanted. He is very knowledgeable and trees and plants. I was extremely impressed. I would recommend him to anyone!
